it is a distributor, not a maker of process heating systems."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Makes utility smart meters, filtration, test equipment and aerospace parts, sold to utilities and defense buyers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors through branches, a distribution business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors, a different product set from heat tracing."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes gas detectors, respirators and fire helmets for worker and fire safety, not heating systems."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Engineered pre-insulated piping for hot fluids in plants, sold via engineering contractors with design and installation services, closely matching Thermon's model."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Formulates specialty chemical fluids, lubricants and coatings for metalworking, a chemical business rather than heating equipment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sells coatings, sealants and consumer paints plus roofing services, with consumer and retail channels absent from Thermon."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Provides on-site inspection and repair services to refineries, which shares customers but not Thermon's heating products."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Makes locks, hinges and metal castings for OEMs and distributors, a hardware business."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures pumps for water, fire and industrial uses, a different equipment category."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Makes bearings and power transmission components for vehicles, rail and machinery, a different product line."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Sells coding and marking printers and water quality instruments, different products from process heating systems."}]}
